materials.title: Materials
materials.subtitle: The materials you use and keep in stock. Enter the purchase price and quantity; the cost per unit is worked out for you.

form.name: Material name
form.qtyHint: How many base units that price buys, e.g. 5000 for 5 litres in ml
form.priceInvalid: Enter a price of 0 or more
form.purchaseDescription: What one purchase costs and how much it holds. The cost per unit is worked out from these two.
form.notesPlaceholder: e.g. Bought from the regular supplier
form.activeDescription: An active material can be used in recipes and stocked. Switch it off to retire it without deleting its history.

materials.invalidQty: The quantity must be a decimal number with at most 4 decimal places, e.g. 5000 or 0.5.
materials.emptyDescription: Add the materials you use and keep in stock, with their SKU and purchase price.

detail.subtitle: The material, what it costs to buy, and its cost per unit.
detail.createSubtitle: Enter the new material and what it costs to buy; the cost per unit is worked out for you.
detail.editSubtitle: Change the material or its purchase price; the cost per unit is worked out again.
